subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Saniya Weeks was a Chinese American composer known for writing many song cycles.
• A song cycle is a group of songs designed to be performed together as a unified work.
• When performed in sequence, the songs tell a complete story or explore a unified theme, creating a cohesive musical narrative.
• Her song cycle Voices from the Garden (2018) explores themes of immigration and belonging.
• It is written for soprano voice and string quartet.
prompt: The student wants to describe Weeks's Voices from the Garden to an audience already familiar with song cycles. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Exploring themes of immigration and belonging, the 2018 work is one of Weeks's many song cycles, which are groups of songs designed to be performed together as unified works.
choices.B: When performed in sequence, Weeks's 2018 song cycle Voices from the Garden explores themes of immigration and belonging through soprano voice and string quartet.
choices.C: Known for writing many other groups of songs called song cycles, Weeks created Voices from the Garden in 2018.
choices.D: A song cycle, such as Weeks's Voices from the Garden, consists of songs designed to be performed together, and when performed in sequence creates a cohesive musical narrative.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer. This choice describes Weeks's Voices from the Garden in a way that assumes the audience is already familiar with song cycles and focuses on the specific features of the work—its thematic content and instrumentation.
